Client Brief

A category without a leader. We built one.

Nuvexa — a division of SGB Group — came to Redmouse with a fundamental challenge: India's campus transformation market was fragmented. Consultants only advise. Architects only design. Equipment vendors only install. No one owned the full stack.

We were tasked with building the brand from zero — strategy, naming rationale, identity, voice, and the complete collateral system needed to walk into a school board meeting and win.

Identity System

Logo System & Logomark — Meaning Behind Every Element

Primary — Deep Navy
NU Logomark — Black
Reversed — Campus Cream
The NÜ ArrowThe upward-right arrow embedded in the N letterform encodes direction at the typographic level — direction and growth built into every letter.
The Chevron XThe gold chevron replaces the conventional X — signalling momentum, forward movement, and the brand's construction DNA. Not decorative. Structural.
A Division of SGB GroupDeliberately included. SGB Group's construction heritage provides institutional trust that a standalone brand name cannot buy — builder DNA as a credibility signal.
Scale IntegrityThe mark works identically from a 16px digital favicon to a 3-metre site hoarding. No modification required. Designed once, deployed everywhere.

Colour System

Five Colours. Each with a Job.

Deep Navy
#0A2540
Primary brand surface. Logos, headlines, dominant backgrounds. Boardroom-grade authority.
Prestige Gold
#C5A059
Premium accent. Section borders, hover states, award badges. Bridges formality with energy.
Campus Cream
#F4F4F0
Primary canvas. Warm off-white — more human than stark white. Reflects transformation, not renovation.
Campus Teal
#045E53
Heritage and depth. Connects the brand to living campus environments and growing institutions.
Builder Terracotta
#894029
Action and urgency. Reserved for primary CTAs and structural commitments. Never decorative.
